china/forbidden-city.name: Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square
china/forbidden-city.description: The imperial palace complex of the Ming and Qing emperors, beside the vast square at the centre of Beijing.
china/forbidden-city.details: The Forbidden City has nearly 1,000 buildings and was the home of 24 emperors. Entry is by timed ticket and passport, and tickets sell out in peak months. Allow three hours and walk north from Tiananmen Gate through to Jingshan Park for a view over the golden roofs. The palace is closed on Mondays.

image.title: File:Forbidden City View of Tiananmen Square (9862820565).jpg
image.author: Gary Todd from Xinzheng, China

china/mutianyu-great-wall.name: Great Wall at Mutianyu
china/mutianyu-great-wall.description: A restored section of the Great Wall with watchtowers, cable car and a toboggan down.
china/mutianyu-great-wall.details: Mutianyu is about 90 minutes from central Beijing, and less crowded than Badaling. A cable car or chairlift reaches the wall, and a toboggan makes the way back down. Walk the stretch between towers 6 and 14 for the best views. Go early on weekdays.

china/temple-of-heaven.name: Temple of Heaven and Summer Palace
china/temple-of-heaven.description: The round blue-roofed temple and the lakeside imperial garden, both in parks locals use every morning.
china/temple-of-heaven.details: The Temple of Heaven is surrounded by a park where people exercise, play cards and dance in the morning. The Summer Palace is a garden of pavilions, bridges and the Kunming Lake, an easy half-day outing by metro.

china/hutongs-duck.name: Hutongs and Peking duck
china/hutongs-duck.description: The old alleys of Beijing, explored by rickshaw or bicycle, ending with a roast duck dinner.
china/hutongs-duck.details: The hutongs are narrow lanes with courtyard homes, small shops and tea houses around the Drum and Bell Towers and Nanluoguxiang. A rickshaw or bike tour is a good introduction. Dinner of Peking duck, carved at the table, is a Beijing ritual. Book popular restaurants.

china/terracotta-army.name: Terracotta Army
china/terracotta-army.description: Thousands of life-size clay warriors guarding the tomb of the first emperor.
china/terracotta-army.details: The Terracotta Army was found by farmers in 1974 near Xi an. Three pits hold the soldiers, horses and chariots, and the largest is Pit 1. A guide gives the story, and the museum shows bronze chariots. It is about an hour from the city by bus or taxi. Go early to avoid the crowds.

china/xian-city-wall.name: Xi an City Wall and Muslim Quarter
china/xian-city-wall.description: A cycle or walk along the Ming-era wall, then street food in the old Muslim Quarter.
china/xian-city-wall.details: The Xi an city wall is 14 kilometres long and can be cycled in about two hours, with the Bell Tower and Drum Tower inside. The Muslim Quarter has night-time stalls with lamb skewers, biang biang noodles and persimmon cakes. The Great Mosque is a tranquil stop.

china/chengdu-pandas.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
china/chengdu-pandas.description: A sanctuary where giant pandas eat bamboo and play, best seen in the morning.
china/chengdu-pandas.details: The panda base is about 40 minutes from central Chengdu and is best at opening time, when the pandas are fed and active. Red pandas live there too. Short cubs can be seen in the nursery in some seasons. Midday heat sends them to sleep.

image.title: File:Chengdu Panda Breeding Research Center, Chengdu, China (Unsplash).jpg
image.author: Chester Ho chesterho

china/leshan-buddha.name: Leshan Giant Buddha
china/leshan-buddha.description: A 71-metre Buddha carved into a cliff at the meeting of three rivers, a UNESCO site.
china/leshan-buddha.details: The Leshan Buddha was carved in the eighth century and is the tallest stone Buddha in the world. A boat gives a view from the river, and a stairway leads down beside it. It is about two hours from Chengdu by train and bus, and queues build at the steps in holidays.

china/sichuan-food.name: Sichuan hotpot and opera
china/sichuan-food.description: Chengdu famously spicy cuisine, a teahouse and an evening of face-changing opera.
china/sichuan-food.details: Chengdu is a UNESCO city of gastronomy, with hotpot, mapo tofu and dan dan noodles. A traditional teahouse in People s Park is a relaxing break, and a Sichuan opera show includes the famous face-changing. Ask for the spice level to be reduced if you need it.

china/li-river-cruise.name: Li River cruise
china/li-river-cruise.description: A boat ride between limestone karst peaks from Guilin to Yangshuo.
china/li-river-cruise.details: The Li River cruise passes the scenery printed on the 20-yuan note, with bamboo rafts, water buffalo and conical peaks. The trip takes about four hours from Guilin to Yangshuo. Mist is common and adds drama, but views are best in clear weather. Bring a hat and sun cream.

china/yangshuo-countryside.name: Yangshuo countryside by bike
china/yangshuo-countryside.description: Cycling among karst hills, rice paddies and villages along the Yulong River.
china/yangshuo-countryside.details: Yangshuo is a backpacker town on the Li River, surrounded by peaks. A bike ride along the Yulong River passes the Moon Hill arch, bamboo raft stops and small villages. The West Street has bars and restaurants, and a night show on the river by Zhang Yimou is popular.

china/the-bund.name: The Bund and Pudong skyline
china/the-bund.description: The colonial waterfront and the futuristic towers opposite, best at night.
china/the-bund.details: The Bund is a promenade lined with historic banks and hotels looking across the Huangpu River to Pudong and the Oriental Pearl Tower. The view from the Pudong side from an observation deck is spectacular. Go at dusk and stay for the lights.

china/yu-garden-old-city.name: Yu Garden and Shanghai old city
china/yu-garden-old-city.description: A Ming-dynasty garden with rockeries and pavilions, near a bazaar of snack stalls.
china/yu-garden-old-city.details: Yu Garden is a classical garden of ponds, bridges and halls. The bazaar outside is touristy but good for soup dumplings, or xiaolongbao. French Concession streets nearby make a nice contrast for a stroll with cafes and plane trees.

china/zhujiajiao.name: Zhujiajiao water town
china/zhujiajiao.description: A canal village with stone bridges and boat rides, an hour from Shanghai.
china/zhujiajiao.details: Zhujiajiao is an ancient water town with covered bridges and narrow lanes along canals. Rowing boats take visitors along the waterways. It is a quiet escape from the city and can be reached by metro and bus.
